In summary, our research is concerned with
the regulation of the exocytotic process in the beta-cell.
the regulation of insulin secretion from the pancreatic beta cell.

the regulation of the exocrine pancreas and its islet cells, in particular the mechanisms by which the hormones secretin and cholecystokinin regulate the secretion of digestive enzymes from the pancreas and the secretion of insulin from pancreatic islet cells.
